description: Same as straight_5m_then_left_door, but with approach_dist_m 0.05 (as src/f1tenth_behavior/missions/straight_2m_then_left_door_direct.json): EnterDoor's goal is the door itself, no pre-point 1.24 m back on the door axis. WHY an alternative: these start poses leave the doorway BESIDE the car at the end of the 5 m (2 m to the left, axis across the heading), so the default pre-point needs a loop or a reverse; on the fake-sim test (2026-11-23, test_fake_3modes) all three modes failed door_needs_steered_reverse there. Select it in batch.yaml (mission:) to measure that difference.
